usedFor: Shopify holds the shoppers and Chatbot AI keeps their profiles, so “Abandoned Checkout” can feed “Add Or Update Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Add Or Update Contact” in Chatbot AI
bestTemplate.why: A shopper who left a checkout gets a profile in Chatbot AI, or an updated one.

watchOut: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify is polling, so profiles reach Chatbot AI after a scheduled check.
